messages:
Carmen: Tiny challenge idea  who's up for a "Commute Swap" week? Run/bike/walk to office instead of transit, log it in a shared spreadsheet, winner gets a $25 coffee card. Friendly leaderboard + CO2 bragging rights. :bicyclist: :runner:

Theo: Love it. I'll swap in a bike commute Tue/Thu. What counts as a day? >50% of commute active? :thinking_face:

Izzy: Agree 50% is fair. Also can we include a one-off kayak commute if water levels allow? (joke but low-key tempted) :rowing_man:

Victor: I'm in for walking 3x this week. Also will sponsor if we hit 10 participants. :raised_hands:

Carmen: Rules suggestion: log date, mode (run/walk/bike), distance, time, and optional selfie. 1 point per active commute day, bonus point for >10km. Spreadsheet will auto-sum. Winner = most points. HR covers the coffee card but we'll keep it small and friendly. Sound good? :sparkles:

Theo: Sounds great. Will someone make the sheet? Also can we add a column for "mood" so we can rate energy after commute? lol

Izzy: I can make the sheet and post link. Mood column yes. Also pro tip: bring a change of shirt + deodorant to the office stash. I'll drop a mini-kit by the gym. :shirt:

wellness-bot: Announcement: Redwood Wellness perk reminder  reimbursements up to $40/month for active transport or fitness classes. See HR portal. (automated)

Victor: Nice. If we get 8+ people maybe do a small prize for most CO2 avoided (calculator in sheet). I can do the math.

Carmen: Posted sheet: https://tiny.redwood/commute-swap (link). Sign up column + a spot to volunteer as "commute buddy" for first-timers. Will start Monday. :calendar:

Theo: Signed up. Planning to bike at 7:15. DM me if you're new to clipless pedals. :bike:

Izzy: Signed for Wed/Thu runs. Also if anyone wants a group walk from the south entrance I'll lead 8:30 on Mon/Wed. Low pace. :walking:

Victor: Also thinking a little midweek "treat": winner announced Friday, coffee and pastries in the kitchen at 10am. Friendly bragging rights and a sticker. :coffee: :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:

Carmen: Love it. Final: sign up by Sunday night. Questions? Brag posts welcome. :trophy:

Theo: Quick Q  how are we verifying? Honest polling + selfies optional. Keep it lax.

Izzy: Agreed  keep it trust-based. We're coworkers not auditors. :sweat_smile:

wellness-bot: Reminder: Safety first. Wear lights at dawn/dusk. Helmets required for bike commutes. (automated)

Victor: Helmets on. Also offering a spare pump and patch kit from my desk for anyone who needs it. DM me.

Carmen: Great energy y'all. Let's move. :muscle:
